description: Index of verified Sandcastle template bundles (.sctpl). Each entry points at a bundle that carries its own proof-of-execution: recorded cassettes that `sandcastle template verify` replays offline at $0. The sha256 is the checksum of the bundle file itself - pass it to `sandcastle template install --sha256` to pin the download.
